data.body: Commit 6b431564084 (tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_fix_versions_live.py + README section): make verify exit 0, 15:03-15:43 PST 2026-11-12 (21221 passed, 29 skipped; integration 218 passed, 2 skipped). The 4 tests collect under pytest -m external tests/external/live_jira_dc with the jira_live marker. A local run against Docker DC was not possible: under arm64 emulation the harness Tomcat did not start within the plugin's 1-hour limit (BUILD FAILURE), so the live evidence will come from the jira-dc-harness job after merge. Search waits were added before each follow-up pass, because the outbound diff reads fixVersions from JQL search and would otherwise re-plan an add that already landed. Pushed as Gerrit 3384.
